name_en: Marcus-Spielman-Srivastava theorem on biregular bipartite Ramanujan graphs
canonical_name: Existence of infinite families of biregular bipartite Ramanujan graphs
statement_blocker: MSS Theorem 5.6 is the exact lexical and historical match, but the catalog does not state c,d >= 3, the finite simple bipartite graph model, side-degree and bipartition conventions, treatment and multiplicity of the two trivial eigenvalues, the non-strict spectral bound, or the nonrepetition/unbounded-size meaning of an infinite sequence. These must be frozen from an admitted immutable source and independently reviewed before a canonical proposition is selected.
domain_and_universes: Expected finite undirected loopless graph carriers, two bipartition sides, natural degrees c and d, real adjacency matrices, and a Nat-indexed family; exact carriers, universe levels, finiteness witnesses, graph representation, and typeclass data remain open.
conclusion: Open pending source admission: the leading candidate says that for every c,d >= 3 there exists an infinite size-growing sequence of finite (c,d)-biregular bipartite graphs whose nontrivial adjacency eigenvalues have absolute value at most sqrt(c-1)+sqrt(d-1).
degenerate_case_status: No case is formally excluded at intake because no canonical proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every degree, carrier, bipartition, spectrum, simplicity, connectivity, and sequence case listed in scope-map.md.

Interlacing Families IV and its every-size multigraph theorem
